first.rationale: Aggressive competitor pricing makes a targeted SMB pricing test timely, and memory_73 reports strong acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its archived record first because sustainable qualified revenue depends on whether discounts preserved retention, expansion, and customer quality—not just near-term acquisition.

final.rationale: Reject promotional pricing because the verified source shows a 12% decline in 30-day retention despite short-term revenue gains. Run an onboarding-simplification experiment instead: onboarding completion is currently down 4%, and prior evidence indicates shorter, lower-friction flows improve completion, time-to-value, and activation. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation to ensure the lift is sustainable.
